house.description: Clean Water Council's clean water fund recommendations required to be broken out by fiscal year.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to clean water fund; requiring Clean Water Council's clean water fund recommendations to be broken out by fiscal year; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 114D.30, subdivision 7.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 114D.30, subdivision 7, is amended to read:

Subd. 7.
Reports to legislature.
By January 15 each odd-numbered year, the council must submit a report to the legislature that includes:
(1) a summary of the activities for which money has been or will be spent in the current biennium;
(2) the recommendations required under subdivision 6 for how money in the clean water fund should be spent in the next biennium, [+broken out by fiscal year and +]including recommended legislative bill language; and
(3) the impact on economic development of the implementation of efforts to protect and restore groundwater and the impaired waters program.
